Is The Wine Goat the official WSET website?

No. The Wine Goat is an independent exam preparation platform. It is not affiliated with or approved by the Wine & Spirit Education Trust: to sit the exam you need to enrol with an Approved Programme Provider.
What can I use for free?
You can start every level straight away, free and without a credit card.
Can The Wine Goat replace the WSET course?
No, it complements it. The course and official materials give you the knowledge; The Wine Goat trains you to recall it and write it well on exam day.
Which languages is it available in?
English, Italian and French, and you can switch at any time: useful if you study in your own language but sit the exam in English.
How long does it take to prepare for a WSET exam?
It depends on the level and your starting point: a few weeks of short daily sessions are usually enough for Level 1, while Levels 2 and 3 need regular study over a few months on top of course hours.
Does The Wine Goat cover the WSET spirits courses?
Yes. Spirits Levels 1 and 2 are already in the app, with lessons, practice questions with explanations, flashcards and mock exams; Level 3 is in preparation. You can start free.
Ready to pass your WSET exam first time?
It takes 2 minutes to build your plan. Free.
